snippet.title: How to Build High Performing Engineering Teams
snippet.description:
What's the key to building high-performing engineering teams? 

In our new HackerRank TV episode, HackerRank's CEO, Vivek Ravisanar, and Atlassian's Head of Platform, Mike Tria, discuss how to assess developer candidates, and share the common mistakes first-time engineering managers make.

snippet.title: Building High Performance Engineering Teams | Sara Milne & Paul Hill | HR.main() London
snippet.description: For our final panel of the day, SVP of Customer Success, Garuav Verma, sat down with Sara Milne, Engineering Culture & Capability Lead at Lloyds Banking Group and Paul Hill, Senior Director, Software Engineering at Bazaarvoice. As leaders within their respective engineering orgs, they shared perspective on how the technical function thinks about tech hiring.

snippet.title: Inside the Minds of 71,000 Developers | Gaurav Verma | HR.main() London
snippet.description: Every year, we survey our community of over 5 million developers to better understand their priorities: what skills they’re learning, what they’re looking for in a job, and more. This year, 71,000 developers from our community shared their insights. These were just a few of the key takeaways we found for hiring teams.

snippet.title: Creating a Better Interview | Gayle Laakmann McDowell | HR.main() Palo Alto
snippet.description: A fireside chat between HackerRank CEO & CoFounder, Vivek Ravisankar and Gayle Laakmann McDowell, author of bestselling book “Cracking the Coding Interview.” As one of the foremost experts on technical interviews, we got Gayle's take on what makes the perfect interview: what teams are doing right, and the opportunities they’re missing when evaluating technical candidates.

snippet.title: Growing University Hiring | Bryan Powell, Twilio | HR.main() Palo Alto
snippet.description:
Bryan Powell, who oversees hiring at Twilio, offers insight into the company's unique approach to university hiring, or rather, early career hiring. This includes anyone who’s early in their development career, whether they’re in school or not: veterans in their second act, career changers enrolled in coding bootcamps, and more. 

To learn more about what leaders from Atlassian, Twilio, and more have to say about tech hiring, visit http://hr.gs/oslb0s

snippet.title: Rethinking Diversity | Aubrey Blanche, Atlassian | HR.main() Palo Alto
snippet.description:
Atlassian's Global Head of Diversity and Belonging, Aubrey Blanche, shares how organizations can implement diversity and inclusion (D&I) in a meaningful way. “You don’t have to move the whole mountain. None of us can do that alone.” The goal, instead, is to focus on affecting change at a team level.

For more insights from our event, visit http://hr.gs/oslb0s

snippet.title: The Emergence of Gen Z | Jawahar Malhotra | HR.main() Palo Alto

snippet.title: How to Evaluate Tech Skills Better [Bonus AMA with VMWare]
snippet.description:
In this webinar we unpack tried-and-true approaches to simplifying your tech hiring process and improving the quality of your candidates. Listen to Tony Torelli from VMware speak firsthand to learn how they transformed their recruiting process into a high-performance hiring machine. 

You’ll learn how to:

- Assess the right technical skills prior to onsite interview
- Use a data-driven approach to inform all hiring decisions
- Reduce phone screening time by up to 75%

- How successful organizations provide a great candidate experience to build their talent brand

- Features to evaluate in a skill-assessment platform, including compliance and scalability

- Make the hiring process more inclusive without diluting the challenge of the job

- Move beyond resumes to streamline applicant screening and ensure the best talent moves to the top of your candidate list

snippet.description:
One of the most important foundations for a successful technical recruiting organization is its alignment with the engineering org. Using data from a survey of over 1,000 technical recruiters and hiring managers, we’ve compiled actionable advice in the new Tech Recruiter’s Guide to Smarter Hiring, a comprehensive guide to current trends for the savvy tech recruiter.

snippet.title: Front-End, Back-End, and Full-Stack: Best Practices for Hiring Software Developers
snippet.description:
Whether you need a seasoned full-stack engineer to serve as the foundation of a key team or a bright and trainable front-end developer to build and execute, it’s important to look beyond a pedigreed resume and “x number years of experience” to ensure you're talking with the best candidates.

Join this webinar to learn how organizations are moving beyond resumes and accurately evaluating developer skills with role-based assessments. We’ll explore:
- What companies are doing to create an on-the-job experience with real-world challenges  
- Why role-based assessments help improve the candidate experience and give hiring managers better visibility into an applicant's skill set
- Steps to assess senior candidates holistically, gaining visibility into how they approach system design, architecture, design patterns, and more

snippet.title: 2018 Tech Recruiting Report Webinar
snippet.description:
Watch this webinar as we discuss insights uncovered in the 2018 Technical Recruiting Report from HackerRank. We explore:

- How hiring managers and recruiters measure success differently and why this mismatch affects the quality of candidates
- Steps to achieve alignment on expectations for a developer role
- What companies are doing to expand their candidate pool to find the software developers they need

snippet.title: HackerRank Story - Lets make the world flat!
snippet.description:
The HackerRank team is on a mission to flatten the world by restructuring the DNA of every company on the planet. We rank programmers based on their coding skills, helping companies source great programmers and reduce the time to hire. As a result, we are revolutionizing the way companies discover and evaluate talented engineers.

The HackerRank platform is the destination for the best engineers to hone their skills and companies to find top engineers.

Through this partnership, Flipkart was able to identify top notch tech talent and build a fabulous engineering team, thus enabling them to further solidify their position as a world-class tech company.

snippet.title: VMware partners with HackerRank for efficient, unbiased tech hiring
snippet.description: VMware is always hiring top engineers, so they're always looking for ways to streamline that process. VMware partnered with HackerRank to make sure they were sourcing, screening, and hiring the best engineers in the most efficient way possible.

snippet.title: How Squarespace Actively Engages and Sources Engineers [Webinar]
snippet.description:
As most recruiters know, LinkedIn is no longer an effective source for engaging engineering talent. Engineers are getting handfuls of messages a day from recruiters (are you one of them?) trying to make that first interaction and sell them on a specific role. However, you can’t just depend on one platform to do all the work. In order to make yourself stand out, you have to utilize other resources and techniques.
 
So, what are those techniques that will make engineers interested in learning more about your company? 

Steven Wood, Technical Recruiter at Squarespace, shares the secret sauce of how he successfully engages and sources engineers at Squarespace (think Chrome extensions, x-raying, geotagging – music to your ears yet?). He’ll also share how leveraging your resources and speaking directly with your internal engineering team can put you one step ahead of the curve.

In this webinar, you’ll learn:
 
-How to write sourcing messages that attract engineers
-Best practices and channels to leverage when sleuthing the web 
-How to use data to optimize your sourcing processes to get better and faster each time

snippet.title: 5 strategies for being a tech recruiting champion with HackerRank [Webinar]
snippet.description:
Implementing innovative technologies is always challenging within organizations. Professionals are rightfully reluctant to change something that seems to be working for the promise of something that may work better. When you know you’ve got something special, how do you encourage your peers to support your new initiative?

In this webinar, we’ll join HackerRank and our guest speaker, Linda Condon, Head of University Recruiting and Pure Storage, while we talk about how you can win the hearts and minds of fellow recruiters, engineering managers, and candidates by using HackerRank to transform their recruiting process.

We’ll show you how to:

- Leverage better candidate insights earlier in the recruitment process.
- Demonstrate to engineering managers how data-driven tech recruiting can help transform their engineering teams.
- Provide a new, engaging experience for engineering candidates.

snippet.title: How Evernote Enhanced Their Tech Recruiting Process
snippet.description: Like many growing companies in the bay area, Evernote struggled to hire elite technical talent quickly. In this webinar, lead recruiter at Evernote, Kelly Grossart, shares how the Evernote recruiting team has created a better interview experience for candidates and hiring managers, rebuilt the technical interview plan, and leveraged HackerRank and Greenhouse to find and hire top technical talent.

snippet.title: An Inside Look at Coinbase's Recruiting Strategy [webinar]
snippet.description:
Moderated by Greenhouse and HackerRank, "Hiring Hacks: An Inside Look at Coinbase's Recruiting Approach" will explore how the organization worked to attract technical talent, hire passionate people, leverage referral programs and offer an exceptional candidate experience. During the webinar, Coinbase recruiting manager Aurora Harshner will share details from her own experience and provide insights into the company's culture. In addition, Harshner will discuss innovative ways that Coinbase is approaching the recruiting process, in order to overcome the obstacles and compete for today's top candidates. Session attendees will learn best practices for technical recruiting, scaling culture, promoting employer brand and tapping into an existing user base.

Human resource professionals, recruiters and hiring managers who are interested in transforming and improving the recruiting process at their organization are encouraged to attend this engaging webinar.

snippet.title: VMware's Mat Connot details his favorite new way to engage top programmers
snippet.description: HackerRank's new Company Pages feature allows any company the opportunity to interact directly with HackerRank's passionate developer community. You can post CodeChallenges, host live coding events, and update your followers on events and important announcements. Plus, when one of your followers completes one of your CodeChallenges, they can choose to share their contact information with you so you can recruit them directly.
